name: Philemon
overview: The book of Philemon is a personal letter from Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, to Philemon, a beloved fellow laborer and Christian in Colosse. Paul expresses gratitude for Philemon's love and faith toward the Lord Jesus and all the saints, emphasizing the importance of faith being active and effective through the acknowledgment of every good thing found in Christ Jesus. This letter highlights the relational and spiritual bonds within the Christian community and encourages grace and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
